ruleDefinitions.name: Password Provided In Command Line Of Net.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a when net.exe is called with a password in the command line

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "net\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "net1\.exe")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ use\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:*\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/USER\\:*\\ *.*"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX("\\ $"))
